# UNCOMPLICATED URINARY TRACT INFECTIONS

# Uncomplicated UTI is an infection confined to the bladder in afebrile women or men without urinary catheter. Symptoms include dysuria, lower abdominal pain, and urgency.

NOT signs or symptoms: abnormal urinalysis alone, pyuria, falls, change in urine odor or color, delirium (acute mental status change, confusion) without systemic signs of infection. These may occur in patients with a UTI but alone are inadequate for diagnosis and empiric treatment.

---

For patients without signs or symptoms of UTI:
[Asymptomatic bacteriuria](asymp-bacteriuria)

Therapy:
## Men, empirical treatment

Preferred:
[Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO q12h R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min, for 7 days](psozid2-nitrofurantoin-sa-7ds-100-mg-po-bid)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-nitrofurantoin-sa-7ds-100-mg-po-bid)
< OR >
[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI for 7 days](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-7days-1ds-tab-bid)

Primary alternative:
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h R for 7 days](psozid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-7ds-po-bid)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-7ds-po-bid)

Secondary alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h R,DI for 5 days](psozid2-ciprofloxacin-5ds-500mg-po-bid)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-ciprofloxacin-5ds-500mg-po-bid)

## Women, empirical treatment

Preferred:
[Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO q12h R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min, for 5 days](psozid2-nitrofurantoin-sa-100mg-bid-5ds)
\*Avoid nitrofurantoin in the third trimester
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-nitrofurantoin-sa-100mg-bid-5ds)
< OR >
[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI for 3 days](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-3days-1ds-tablet-bid)
\*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-3days-1ds-tablet-bid)

Primary alternatives:
[Fosfomycin 3GM sachet PO M once](psozid-fosfomycin-3gm-sachet-po-x-1-dose)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-fosfomycin-3gm-sachet-po-x-1-dose)
<OR>
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h R for 5 days](psozid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-5ds-po-bid)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-5ds-po-bid)

Secondary alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h R,DI for 3 days](psozid2-ciprofloxacin-3ds-500mg-po-bid)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-ciprofloxacin-3ds-500mg-po-bid)

## Women, suppression

\*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters
\*Avoid nitrofurantoin in the third trimester
[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1/2 SS tablet PO q24h R,DI](psozid-trimeth-sulfa-1-2-ss-po-qday)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-2-ss-po-qday)
< OR >
[Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 SS tablet PO once post-coitus R,DI](psozid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ss-po-postcoitus)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ss-po-postcoitus)
< OR >
[Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO qhs R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min](psozid-nitrofurantoin-sa-100mg-po-qhs)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-nitrofurantoin-sa-100mg-po-qhs)
< OR >
[Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO once post-coitus R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min](psozid-nitrofurantoin-sa-100mg-po-postcoitus)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-nitrofurantoin-sa-100mg-po-postcoitus)
